text:
My being swollen with white ships.

My being bursting with feelings.

All of me beneath the reminiscences of your eyes.

I want to destroy the itching of your eyelashes.

I want to flee the restlessness of your lips.

Why does your phantasmagoric vision round out the chalices of these hours?

translation.title: Distance
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the bodily unease of eyelashes and lips against the distant white ships.
